description: Generate all HTTP layer files: Controllers (Admin, Client, Public, Auth), Form Requests, and route files (web.php, admin.php, client.php)
steps: Create app/Http/Controllers/Controller.php (base controller)
Create app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.php with show(), login(), logout() methods
Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/DashboardController.php injecting DashboardService, calling getDonneesDashboard()
Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/OrderController.php injecting CommandeService and TarificationService. Methods: index, create, store, show, edit, update, updateStatus, setPrixFinal, destroy
Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ClientController.php injecting ClientService. CRUD methods
Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/CatalogueController.php injecting CatalogueService. CRUD for modeles
Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/CategoryController.php injecting CatalogueService for categories
Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/AccessoryController.php injecting AccessoryService
Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/PortfolioController.php injecting PortfolioService
Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/MeasurementController.php injecting MesureService
Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/ReminderController.php injecting NotificationService
Create app/Http/Controllers/Admin/PricingController.php injecting TarificationService for AJAX price calculation
Create app/Http/Controllers/Public/CatalogueController.php with index() and show() for public catalogue
Create app/Http/Controllers/Public/PortfolioController.php with index() for public portfolio
Create app/Http/Controllers/Public/PreorderController.php with create() and confirmation()
Create app/Http/Controllers/Public/SuiviController.php with showCommande() and showClient() for public tracking
Create app/Http/Controllers/Client/OrderTrackingController.php with index() and show() for client space
Create app/Http/Controllers/Client/PreorderController.php with store() for submitting preorders
Create app/Http/Controllers/Client/ProfileController.php with show() and update()

Create all Form Requests in app/Http/Requests/Admin/: StoreOrderRequest, UpdateOrderRequest, StoreClientRequest, UpdateClientRequest, StoreModelRequest, UpdateModelRequest, StoreCategoryRequest, StoreAccessoryRequest, StorePortfolioRequest, StoreReminderRequest, StoreMeasurementRequest
Create app/Http/Requests/Client/StorePreorderRequest.php and UpdateProfileRequest.php
Create routes/web.php with public routes (home, catalogue, portfolio, preorder, suivi), auth routes, and requires admin.php + client.php
Create routes/admin.php with /admin prefix, auth+admin middleware, resource routes for all admin controllers
Create routes/client.php with /espace-client prefix, auth+client middleware, order tracking and profile routes
Create routes/console.php (empty, standard Laravel)
acceptance_criteria: All PHP files pass php -l syntax check
DashboardController injects DashboardService and calls getDonneesDashboard()
OrderController injects CommandeService (not OrderService) and TarificationService (not PricingService)
Route names are consistent: admin.dashboard, admin.commandes.*, admin.clients.*, client.orders.*, public.catalogue.*, public.portfolio.*
Admin routes use auth + EnsureIsAdmin middleware
Client routes use auth + EnsureIsClient middleware
All controller methods reference correct service method names
verification: Run find /projects/sandbox/Atelier-couture -path '*/Http/*' -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \; and confirm no syntax errors
Run find /projects/sandbox/Atelier-couture/routes -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \; and confirm no syntax errors
findings: Public controllers use namespace App\Http\Controllers\PublicSite (not Public) to avoid PHP reserved word conflict. All files pass php -l. Route files use class references for middleware (EnsureIsAdmin::class, EnsureIsClient::class).
